content:
Unveiled alongside the new Mac mini, Apple today announced the next-generation Mac Studio. The all-new Mac Studio lineup features the M5 Max and M5 Ultra chips, with unified memory supporting up to 512GB.

The new Mac Studio models are available for order starting today.

M5 Max Mac Studio

First up, Apple announced a new Mac Studio powered by the M5 Max, an upgrade from last year's M4 Max model. The M5 Max first appeared earlier this year in the MacBook Pro.

The M5 Max features an 18-core CPU, comprising 6 performance cores and 12 efficiency cores. The GPU can be configured with up to 40 cores, with each core featuring a built-in Neural Accelerator. Apple says GPU performance is up to 50% faster than the previous generation. Unified memory bandwidth reaches up to 614GB/s, up from the M4 Max's maximum of 546GB/s.

The M5 Max Mac Studio starts with 36GB of unified memory, with support for up to 128GB. This matches the original launch specs of the M4 Max Mac Studio. However, over the past year, Apple has gradually trimmed configuration options amid industry-wide chip shortages. As of yesterday, the M4 Max Mac Studio was available with memory configurations from 36GB up to 96GB.

Below are some of the benchmark results Apple published for the M5 Max Mac Studio:

  • Up to 10.7x faster LLM prompt processing in LM Studio compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.9x faster than M4 Max.
  • Up to 7.4x faster text-to-image performance compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3.5x faster than M4 Max.
  • Up to 5.3x faster Magic Mask performance in Blackmagic Design DaVinci Resolve Studio compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 3x faster than M4 Max.
  • Up to 3.5x faster basecalling for DNA sequencing in Oxford Nanopore MinKNOW compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Max, and up to 1.9x faster than M4 Max.

M5 Ultra Mac Studio

The real star of today's show is the M5 Ultra Mac Studio.

The new M5 Ultra Mac Studio features up to a 36-core CPU, comprising 12 performance cores and 24 efficiency cores. Multi-threaded performance is up to 1.3x faster than the previous-generation M3 Ultra Mac Studio.

The M5 Ultra packs up to an 80-core GPU, which Apple calls the most powerful GPU ever in an Apple Silicon chip. This is also the first time Apple has brought Neural Accelerators to an Ultra chip. Neural Accelerators are dedicated hardware within each GPU core, designed specifically to accelerate AI workloads.

On the memory front, the M5 Ultra Mac Studio starts at 96GB and can be configured with up to 512GB. This matches the original launch specs of the M3 Ultra Mac Studio. However, over the past year, Apple reduced the M3 Ultra Mac Studio's memory options to just 96GB due to memory shortages. Memory bandwidth reaches up to 1.2TB/s.

The M5 Ultra's media engine features double the video encode and decode blocks of the M5 Max, supporting simultaneous playback of up to 33 streams of 8K ProRes video.

Apple highlighted the following benchmark results for the M5 Ultra Mac Studio:

  • Up to 15.4x faster CopyCat ML training performance in Foundry Nuke compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 3.3x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • Up to 9.8x faster LLM prompt processing in LM Studio compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • Up to 8.2x faster text-to-image performance compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 4.3x faster than M3 Ultra.
  • Up to 4.7x faster scene rendering in Maxon Redshift compared to a Mac Studio with M1 Ultra, and up to 1.7x faster than M3 Ultra.

More Mac Studio Specs and Details

  • Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 support, powered by the Apple N1 networking chip
  • Support for up to 8 external displays, or up to 4 5K resolution Studio Display XDRs at 120Hz
  • PCIe Gen 6 support, delivering up to 2x faster storage performance
  • Thunderbolt 5 with up to 120Gb/s bandwidth
  • Genlock sync via USB-C support, ensuring precise synchronization between displays and professional cameras.

Mac Studio Pricing and Availability

The Mac Studio with M5 Max starts at $2,499 with 512GB of standard storage, priced the same as the M4 Max Mac Studio. The Mac Studio with M5 Ultra starts at $5,499 with 1TB of storage, a $200 increase over the M3 Ultra version.

Buy Mac Studio from Apple:

  • M5 Max Mac Studio: Starts at $2,499 (Education price: $2,299)
  • M5 Ultra Mac Studio: Starts at $5,499 (Education price: $5,099)

The new Mac Studio lineup is available to order starting today, with deliveries beginning September 22. However, Apple says the M5 Ultra Mac Studio configured with 512GB of memory will be "available late October."
